// Translation of conformance/cases/typecheck/source-format-not-accepted-as-target.json:
//     client.convert().fromZpl(body).to(SourceFormat.PDF)
//
// SourceFormat and TargetFormat are distinct defined types, and SourcePDF is a TYPED
// constant, so it does not implicitly convert. Expected: cannot use labelzoom.SourcePDF
// (constant "pdf" of type labelzoom.SourceFormat) as labelzoom.TargetFormat value
package main

import (
	"context"

	labelzoom "github.com/labelzoom/labelzoom-sdk/go"
)

func main() {
	client, _ := labelzoom.New()
	_, _ = client.Convert(context.Background(), labelzoom.ConvertRequest{
		From: labelzoom.SourceZPL,
		To:   labelzoom.SourcePDF,
		Body: []byte("^XA^XZ"),
	})
}
